name: 15946 · Portage, PA
findings: ZIP 15946 (Portage) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15946 (Portage) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
